# Every settings key, with its levels and type. A test compares it with the
# built-in schema. The format is append-only: to add a key, append its line;
# to add a choice, append it to the end of its line. Never rename or remove a
# key or a choice. The first line is the file layout version. It does not
# change for an added key or choice.
schema_version 1
display.output global name
display.monitor global name
display.style game,system,global choice auto|native|2x|3x|4x
display.refresh_policy game,system,global choice exact|exact_x2|force_50|force_60
